item.title: [CAP-59] Featured Story Card
item.description:
User Intent: As a website visitor, I want to read rich editorial stories with flexible visual layouts, interactively swap main hero photos using supporting gallery thumbnails on desktop, and browse photo carousels on tablet and mobile viewports so that I can immerse myself in the resort's design, history, and surroundings.

Scenarios - Site Visitor (Guest User Experience)

Given When Then
  1. Desktop Viewport Layout
 The page loads on a desktop screen Displays a 2-column split layout: Primary main hero image sits on one side (Left or Right based on author selection); Eyebrow, Main Headline, Body Copy, 1 to 3 supporting gallery thumbnail images, and CTA links sit on the opposite side.
  1. Tablet Viewport Layout
 The page loads on a tablet screen Renders as a structured vertical storytelling block: Eyebrow and Main Headline sit at the top, followed by a primary hero media container with overlay navigation arrows (< / >), body copy, and CTA links below.
  1. Mobile Viewport Layout
 The page loads on a mobile phone screen Transforms into a single-column stacked layout: Eyebrow and Main Headline sit at top, followed by a touch-friendly hero carousel with navigation arrows (< / >) and peeking adjacent image edge, body copy, and CTA links at bottom.
  1. Gallery Thumbnail Image Swap (Desktop Only)
 A visitor clicks any supporting gallery thumbnail image on desktop The primary main hero image frame dynamically updates/swaps to display the selected thumbnail photo in large high-resolution format along with its image details.
  1. Hero Carousel Navigation (Tablet & Mobile)
 A visitor clicks navigation arrows (< / >) or swipes on tablet or mobile viewports The primary hero photo container smoothly scrolls to reveal the next or previous image in the carousel.
  1. CTA Link Action
 A visitor clicks a primary or secondary CTA link The website opens the designated destination URL in the current tab, or in a new browser tab if "Open in new tab" is enabled.

Authoring Specifications (How to Edit This Block)

# Field Name Required? Description
1 Image Alignment Position Yes Toggle option to align the primary media on the Left or Right side on desktop viewports.
2 Story Eyebrow Text Optional Small uppercase section tag displayed above the main headline, e.g., "SENTOSA" or "THE RESORT".
3 Story Main Headline Yes Prominent editorial heading. Supports multi-line text input to allow authors to control line breaks on the live site, e.g., "UNVEIL JUNGLE BETWEEN SKY AND SEA".
4 Body Description Copy Yes Rich text paragraph copy describing the story, architecture, or environment.
5 Primary Media Assets (Single or Carousel) Yes Upload 1 to 3 high-resolution photo assets for the main hero media container.
6 Primary Asset Alt Text Yes (for images) Descriptive alternative text for screen readers when an image asset is used.
7 Gallery Thumbnails List Optional Upload 1 to 3 square supporting thumbnail photos displayed beneath the body copy on desktop viewports.
8 Gallery Thumbnails Alt Text Yes (for images) Descriptive alternative text for screen readers when thumbnail images are used.
9 Primary CTA Label & URL Optional Main text action link, e.g., "DISCOVER MORE". Supports internal relative paths, full absolute URLs, external links, anchor links (#section-id), and an "Open in new tab" toggle.
10 Secondary CTA Label & URL Optional Secondary text action link, e.g., "LEARN MORE". Includes an "Open in new tab" toggle and automatically hides the visual divider line ( ) when 1 or no CTAs are defined.
11 Enable Dark Image Overlay Optional Checkbox toggle to apply a semi-transparent dark overlay tint over primary media to improve text readability.
12 Component Anchor ID Optional Custom text ID (e.g., "story-sentosa") allowing links to jump directly to this block on the page.

Scenarios - Content Author (Website Editor)

Given When Then
  1. Adding Component
 An author opens the authoring environment The website editor adds the Featured Story Card block to a page, opening fields for Alignment, Section Tags, Headline, Body Copy, Media Assets, Gallery Thumbnails, and CTA Links.
  1. Configuring Media & Layout
 An author populates text and uploads 1 to 3 image assets The author selects Image Alignment (Left vs Right), uploads 1 to 3 primary media assets (enabling carousel arrows on tablet/mobile), uploads 1 to 3 gallery thumbnails for desktop swapping, and configures CTA URLs.
  1. Publishing Page
 An author publishes the page The live page displays the flexible storytelling block, rendering interactive thumbnail image swapping on desktop, swipeable arrow carousels on tablet/mobile, and responsive 2-column or stacked layouts.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Desktop 2-Column Layout: Displays a 2-column split layout on desktop screens with authorable media alignment toggling between Left or Right positioning.
  • Desktop Interactive Gallery Thumbnail Swapping: On desktop viewports, clicking any supporting gallery thumbnail image (1 to 3 items) dynamically updates the primary main hero image container to display the selected photo in large high-resolution format with its details.
  • Tablet & Mobile Hero Media Carousel: On tablet and mobile viewports, the primary media container renders as a responsive carousel featuring left/right navigation arrows (< / >) and touch swiping, displaying 1 to 3 media assets.
  • Card Quantity Constraints: Supports a minimum of 1 asset up to a maximum of 3 gallery thumbnail assets.
  • CTA Navigation & Separator Logic: Supports up to 2 optional text action links with underline hover styling. Displays a visual divider line (|) when both CTAs are defined and automatically hides the divider line when 1 or no CTAs are defined.
  • Link Path & Anchor ID Support: CTA link fields accept internal relative paths, full absolute URLs, external links, and page anchor links (#section-id). Supports an optional Component Anchor ID field to allow direct page jumps.
  • Enable Dark Image Overlay: Provides an optional authorable checkbox toggle to apply a semi-transparent dark overlay tint over background media to enhance text legibility.
  • Multi-Line Text Control: Main headlines and body descriptions support author-controlled line breaks (Enter key).

Design Screenshots

  • Desktop View Screenshot: 2-column split layout with left primary hero image, right headline, copy, and 3 gallery thumbnails.
  • Tablet View Screenshot: Vertical storytelling layout with top headline, centered hero image with navigation arrows (< / >), body copy, and CTA link below.
  • Mobile View Screenshot: Compact single-column stacked layout with top headline, swipeable hero image carousel with peeking adjacent image edge, body copy, and CTA link.
